display.title: End City Margin
display.description: Carry the atlas into the End, survey an End City, and return with shulker proof.

tracker.text: Bring 2 shulker shells from the End City.
tracker.complete_text: The shulker shells are ready for the atlas cover.

tracker.text: Bring 16 chorus fruit from the outer islands.
tracker.complete_text: The chorus fruit proves the outer road.

travel.text: Reach the End City near {target_x}, {target_z} in {target_dimension}.

proof.text: Bring shulker shells and chorus fruit from the outer islands.

return.text: Return to the cartographer with the finished atlas margin.

start: The last blank margin waits in the End. Find the city near {target_x}, {target_z}, and bring back shulker shells with chorus fruit.
reminder: End City near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring 2 shulker shells and 16 chorus fruit. The atlas is close to becoming whole.
turn_in: There it is: village road, ruin road, sea or dark roof, fire road, last room, outer island. A whole atlas, and you walked it into truth.
already_completed: The End City margin is already complete.
unavailable: The atlas needs the Stronghold bearing before the End margin can be drawn.
inactive: The End margin is not open right now.
missing_target: The shells need the End City bearing behind them.
missing_proof: Bring shulker shells before I bind the final margin.
locate_failed: The End City mark is too far for the atlas to catch from here.
